summary: The Amoebius race judge's L5 start now raises each hull's Time to level 5 from its card row instead of setting it (#2104), and the judge races Skim Race, timing the Squirrel to the mode's crystal count (#2105).
why: Garrett's Regatta flywheel: L5 had downgraded the four hulls Regatta starts at level 10; the Squirrel had no home-game AI trainer.
